supervision.title: Supervision and mentoring
supervision.description: I welcome inquiries from students and researchers whose interests align with my work on language, cognition, interaction, and AI evaluation. Before getting in touch, please indicate clearly the area you would like to work on and include a brief research proposal. General inquiries are unlikely to receive a response.
